content: Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-16 as the sixth skill. This note replaces the "Not decided" text below. What it owns: strategy and planning. What it does not own: making any piece. wugweb-work produces blog posts, service pages and site copy as well as case studies. Content hands work a brief; work hands back a finished piece.
